correctness.rationale: Read frozen RESULT.md and verified full 14-form basis via valuation at infinity: v(x)=-5,v(y)=-8,v(dx)=26, allowing j=0..3 with i ranges 0..5,0..3,0..2,0. Expand Cartier using y^5=y+f(x), C(x^N dx) only N≡4 mod5 and semilinear fifth roots A,B; four constant pivot columns and a 2x2 residual M=[[2B,2A+B²],[-2A,0]] give det=2A(2A+B²). Hence ranks 4,5,6 and a-number 10/9/8 according to the union of two jump curves (fifth power maps preserve zero sets), for all algebraically closed parameters. Local ring quotient k[[a,b]]/(a,2a+b²) has length two. The involution x→-x splits 6 invariant + 8 anti-invariant differentials (tame degree 2), quotient Cartier rank 2 and constant a-number 4, Prym a-number 6/5/4. Union-count of line/parabola over F_(5^r) gives 1,2(q-1),(q-1)². Independent script generated all 14 Cartier columns from raw monomials for all 25 F5 coefficient pairs and recovered 1,8,16 ranks; analytical polynomial rank proof covers all geometric parameters.
